evidence_quotes:
The purpose of
the vent system is to allow vapor to escape to the atmosphere under normal operation, and to
prevent venting during deep water fording operations.
statements.reason: The stated purpose of the vent system includes allowing vapor to escape under normal operation.
statements.statement: During normal operation, the vent system allows vapor to escape to the atmosphere.

evidence_quotes:
prevent venting during deep water fording operations. If the vents were left open, water would
enter the engine and other systems and cause damage.
statements.reason: The text links preventing venting during fording to keeping water out.
statements.statement: During deep-water fording operations, the vent system prevents venting to avoid water entering the engine and other systems.

evidence_quotes:
If the vents were left open, water would
enter the engine and other systems and cause damage.
statements.reason: The text says water entering those systems would cause damage.
statements.statement: Water entering the engine and other systems during deep-water fording operations could cause damage.

evidence_quotes:
ITEM TO BE INSPECTED: DeepWater
Fording Kit
NOT FULLY MISSION CAPABLE IF: c. Any exhaust extension
leaks.
PROCEDURES: a. Inspect vent tubes for bends,
cracks, breaks, deterioration, and
restrictions.
statements.reason: The DeepWater Fording Kit inspection procedure specifies these vent-tube checks.
statements.statement: During deep-water-fording-kit PMCS, vent tubes are checked for bends, cracks, breaks, deterioration, and restrictions.
